I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I can't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I checked only what Pree can see: #central-team, the Central team digests and the shared files. None of them mention Brackenwater or a renewal date, and Pree can't open any of the account folders. So I have nothing to check the date against.

In the reply I said I'm treating it as unconfirmed hearsay and suggested checking with the Brackenwater contact or whoever holds the account's contract. I also offered to set a calendar reminder once the date is confirmed in writing. I didn't save the date anywhere as fact.
